---
title: "Visualize HOMER annotation stats"
author: "CIG @ MGI"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

```{r config, include=FALSE}
# Repository location, separate from DATA_ROOT. Replace with the absolute path
# to your clone (the directory containing shared-R).
REPO_ROOT <- "/path/to/repo"
REPO_ROOT <- normalizePath(REPO_ROOT, mustWork = TRUE)
# Input locations. Set these before knitting.
DATA_ROOT <- "" # project data directory (per-analysis subdirectories)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = file.path(DATA_ROOT, "Graph_genetic_analysis_New_RI/Intersect_Variants_with_cCREs/"))
set.seed(0)

require("ggplot2")
require("cowplot")
require("viridis")
require("reshape2")
require("dplyr")
library(plotly)
library(Rtsne)
library(stringr)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)
library(WebGestaltR)
require("tidyverse")

source(file.path(REPO_ROOT, "shared-R", "JFMV_2025_Aesthetic.R"))

theme_set(theme_cowplot())
```

```{r import all sites stats}
read.delim("variable_cCRE_format.HOMER.out.stats")->stats

c(1:nrow(stats))[stats[,1]=="Annotation"]->Breakpoint
# Split stats, putting entries above the Breakpoint line into a new data frame and entries below the Breakpoint line into a new data frame

stats[1:(Breakpoint-1),]->GeneFeatures
stats[(Breakpoint+1):nrow(stats),]->GenomicFeatues

rownames(GeneFeatures)<-NULL
rownames(GenomicFeatues)<-NULL

rm(stats)

# Convert Number.of.peaks to numeric
GeneFeatures$Number.of.peaks<-as.numeric(GeneFeatures$Number.of.peaks)
# Convert Total.size..bp. to numeric
GeneFeatures$Total.size..bp.<-as.numeric(GeneFeatures$Total.size..bp.)
# Convert Log2.Ratio..obs.exp. to numeric
GeneFeatures$Log2.Ratio..obs.exp.<-as.numeric(GeneFeatures$Log2.Ratio..obs.exp.)
# Convert LogP.enrichment...values.depleted.
GeneFeatures$LogP.enrichment...values.depleted.<-as.numeric(GeneFeatures$LogP.enrichment...values.depleted.)

# remove empty classes (Number.of.peaks == 0)
GeneFeatures<-GeneFeatures[GeneFeatures$Number.of.peaks>0,]

# Convert Number.of.peaks to numeric
GenomicFeatues$Number.of.peaks<-as.numeric(GenomicFeatues$Number.of.peaks)
# Convert Total.size..bp. to numeric
GenomicFeatues$Total.size..bp.<-as.numeric(GenomicFeatues$Total.size..bp.)
# Convert Log2.Ratio..obs.exp. to numeric
GenomicFeatues$Log2.Ratio..obs.exp.<-as.numeric(GenomicFeatues$Log2.Ratio..obs.exp.)
# Convert LogP.enrichment...values.depleted.
GenomicFeatues$LogP.enrichment...values.depleted.<-as.numeric(GenomicFeatues$LogP.enrichment...values.depleted.)

# remove empty classes (Number.of.peaks == 0)
GenomicFeatues<-GenomicFeatues[GenomicFeatues$Number.of.peaks>0,]


sum(GeneFeatures$Number.of.peaks)
sum(GenomicFeatues$Number.of.peaks)

## HOMER assigns annotations in this order of priority:
# TSS (by default defined from -1kb to +100bp) (aka Promoter)
# TTS (by default defined from -100 bp to +1kb)
# CDS Exons
# 5' UTR Exons
# 3' UTR Exons
# Introns
# Intergenic
# miRNA (their docs don't specify where these go)
# ncRNA (their docs don't specify where these go)
# pseudogenes (their docs don't specify where these go)

# replace "5UTR" with "5' UTR"
GeneFeatures$Annotation[GeneFeatures$Annotation == "5UTR"] <- "5' UTR"

# replace "3UTR" with "3' UTR"
GeneFeatures$Annotation[GeneFeatures$Annotation == "3UTR"] <- "3' UTR"

# order the GeneFeatures$Annotation factor levels
GeneFeatures$Annotation<-factor(GeneFeatures$Annotation, levels = c("Promoter", "TTS", "Exon", "5' UTR", "3' UTR", "Intron", "Intergenic", "miRNA", "ncRNA", "pseudo"), ordered = TRUE)

GeneFeatures$Percent.of.peaks<-GeneFeatures$Number.of.peaks/sum(GeneFeatures$Number.of.peaks)*100

```

```{r GeneFeatures table}
GeneFeatures
```

```{r make figures directory}
# Create directory for figures
if (!dir.exists("Figures/")) {
  dir.create("Figures/", recursive = TRUE)
}
```

```{r plot all sites composition of Gene annotations, include=TRUE, fig.width=3, fig.height=2}
# As bar plots
ggplot(GeneFeatures, aes(x = Annotation, y = Number.of.peaks, fill = Annotation)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, option = "turbo") +
  JFMVTheme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Annotation", y = "Number of peaks") +
  theme(legend.position="none") +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", labels = scales::comma) +
  # remove grid lines
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  # Set plot border thickness
  theme(panel.border=element_rect(fill=NA, color="black", linewidth=0.8, linetype="solid")) -> p1

# As bar plots
ggplot(subset(GeneFeatures, !(Annotation %in% c("miRNA","ncRNA","pseudo","5' UTR")) ), aes(x = Annotation, y = Number.of.peaks/1000, fill = Annotation)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, option = "turbo") +
  JFMVTheme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Annotation", y = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position="none") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth=0.25) +
  # remove grid lines
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  # Set plot border thickness
  theme(panel.border=element_rect(fill=NA, color="black", linewidth=0.8, linetype="solid")) +
  # remove x axis labels
  #theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
  # remove x axis ticks
  theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) -> p2


# As bar plots
ggplot(subset(GeneFeatures, !(Annotation %in% c("miRNA","ncRNA","pseudo","5' UTR")) ), aes(x = Annotation, y = Number.of.peaks/1000, fill = Annotation)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, option = "turbo") +
  JFMVTheme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Annotation", y = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position="none") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,40), expand = c(0,0)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 6, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth=0.25) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 7, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth=0.25) +
  # remove grid lines
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  # Set plot border thickness
  theme(panel.border=element_rect(fill=NA, color="black", linewidth=0.8, linetype="solid")) -> p3

p3 + scale_y_continuous(
  limits = c(0, 100), expand = c(0, 0),
  labels = function(x) paste0("    ", x)  # two spaces in front
) ->p3

p1
p2
p3

# save plots
ggsave("Figures/GeneFeatures_Annotation_Number_Barplot_whole.png", p1, width = 3, height = 2, dpi = 300)
ggsave("Figures/GeneFeatures_Annotation_Number_Barplot_Upper.png", p2, width = 3, height = 2, dpi = 300)
ggsave("Figures/GeneFeatures_Annotation_Number_Barplot_Lower.png", p3, width = 3, height = 2, dpi = 300)

# save as svg
ggsave("Figures/GeneFeatures_Annotation_Number_Barplot_whole.svg", p1, width = 3, height = 2, dpi = 300)
ggsave("Figures/GeneFeatures_Annotation_Number_Barplot_Upper.svg", p2, width = 3, height = 2, dpi = 300)
ggsave("Figures/GeneFeatures_Annotation_Number_Barplot_Lower.svg", p3, width = 3, height = 2, dpi = 300)


```

```{r plot all sites composition of Genomic annotations, include=TRUE, fig.width=8, fig.height=2}
GenomicFeatues$Percent.of.peaks<-GenomicFeatues$Number.of.peaks/sum(GenomicFeatues$Number.of.peaks)*100
```

```{r plot enrichment of Gene annotations, include=TRUE, fig.width=4, fig.height=4}
ggplot(GeneFeatures, aes(x = Annotation, y = Log2.Ratio..obs.exp., fill = Annotation)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, option = "turbo") +
  JFMVTheme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Annotation", y = "Log2 Ratio (observed/expected)") +
  theme(legend.position="none") +
  # remove grid lines
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  # Set plot border thickness
  theme(panel.border=element_rect(fill=NA, color="black", linewidth=0.8, linetype="solid")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth=1) -> p5

p5
```
